overview_description.description: Since its incorporation in 1952 as the first indigenous bank and the first shareholding company in the entire Gulf region, NBK has been known as ‘The Bank You Know And Trust’. Thanks to the recognized excellence of its very stable management along with its unequivocal strategy, consistent profitability, high asset quality and strong capitalization, NBK, throughout the years, succeeded in building an advanced banking institution that offers a full spectrum of innovative and unrivalled financial and investment services and solutions to individuals, corporate and institutional clients. NBK enjoys a dominant market share with a large and ever expanding local and regional clientele. NBK also boasts the largest overseas branch network spanning many of the world financial and business centers.

press_references.value: CBK Directs Kuwait Banks to Immediately Suspend Prize Draws

legal_proceedings.description: The Central Bank of Kuwait (CBK) has directed all banks in Kuwait to suspend prize draws linked to certain customer accounts. This decision is part of CBK's regulatory mandate to ensure transparency and protect consumer interests. The suspension will remain in effect until a thorough evaluation of these products is completed.

press_references.value: Kuwait Cracks Down on Illegal Crypto Mining to Protect National Grid
press_references.publisher: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News and Price Data

legal_proceedings.description: Kuwaiti authorities are investigating over 60 individuals for illegal cryptocurrency mining as part of a nationwide crackdown to protect the national grid. The campaign includes disconnecting power from mining-linked properties and is backed by an absolute ban on crypto mining enforced by the anti-money laundering committee and regulators such as the National Bank of Kuwait.
